fb_feed.text:
"My guys won't use another app."

Good. There isn't one.

No app to install. No login. No training. No rollout meeting. Your crew texts their notes the same way they already text you — and FieldNotes turns those texts into service logs, action items, and a daily recap.

That's the whole design. Field crews live in their text threads, not in dashboards. If a tech needs training to use your software, the software failed — so there's nothing to train.

And the cost objection? A month of FieldNotes costs less than one botched visit. Less than one disputed invoice you couldn't defend. One saved callback pays for it.

I built it for my own commercial service business in Atlanta — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area — because my crew wouldn't use software either. Now they don't have to. They just text.

Try the 60-second demo — 30 days free, no credit card: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
